tasks.listening-speaking-t2: Topic: Listening and Speaking. Cover daily routines, the school day, food and shopping conversations, polite request forms, and giving or following simple directions in the community. Ask learners to identify courteous phrases, choose correct responses in short dialogues, interpret direction words, and sequence spoken instructions accurately.
tasks.reading-viewing-t2: Topic: Reading and Viewing. Cover simple stories, menus, advertisements, instructions, and timetables. Ask learners to identify main ideas, retrieve useful details such as time and price, match instructions to actions, interpret the purpose of an advertisement, and apply scanning strategies to familiar everyday texts.
tasks.writing-presenting-t2: Topic: Writing and Presenting. Cover diary lines, shopping lists, short instructions, simple descriptions, and short messages linked to school and home contexts. Ask learners to choose suitable text formats, organise ideas in sequence, apply audience and purpose, and edit short writing for clarity, spelling, and punctuation.
tasks.language-structures-t2: Topic: Language Structures and Conventions. Cover question forms, negatives, adjectives, possessives, and present and past tense control in simple sentences. Ask learners to form or identify correct questions, transform sentences into negatives, choose accurate adjective or possessive forms, and keep tense usage consistent in context.
